If WE view there is a risk, we will look at delaying the departure time, rescheduling the trip if we both have the ability to reschedule, or canceling the trip and providing a full refund. A decision to cancel for weather is SOLELY up to the professional discretion of our experienced Captains. If we determine there is a risk of unfavorable weather, we may delay the departure time, reschedule the trip if possible, or cancel the trip if absolutely necessary.
